_readme: B's originals for the Live TV filler library (B, 20 Oct 2026). HQ writes this file. Each key is a show slug in the catalog (add the show the usual way first, so it plays). They fill the gaps before each daypart, ahead of TV specials and break cards. audience: everyone, kids or after-dark (11 pm to 6 am only). season: none, halloween, thanksgiving, christmas, valentines or easter. channels: channel ids; kinds: all, row, collection, network. Leave both empty for every channel except Late Night. Example entry: "my-skits": { "audience": "everyone", "season": "none", "channels": [], "kinds": [] }
